creator: Alexander Terp
description: Muster watches the config file's directory, so it sees a save that replaces the file (what editors do) but not one written in place, such as printf > config.toml or some editors' write-in-place mode. The save then does nothing until the next replacing save or a relaunch. Either watch the file as well as the directory, or say in docs/configuration.md that a save must replace the file.
title: The config watcher misses a config written in place
